title: VKnowU: Evaluating Visual Knowledge Understanding in Multimodal LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-only LLMs without visual inputs (a 'blind VQA' scenario) to answer multiple-choice questions, measuring their accuracy to identify and discard questions that can be solved using linguistic shortcuts or text priors alone.

Transcribing video audio tracks using Whisper and computing the semantic similarity between the generated subtitles and ground-truth answers to discard questions that rely heavily on audio cues rather than visual knowledge.
Shuffling the order of multiple-choice options during the dataset curation and human verification process to prevent models from exploiting positional shortcuts.
